_notes: Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint (https://api.anthropic.com/v1/): chat completions and the model list only. Everything else (embeddings, rerank, images, video, speech, transcription, decisions) has no compatible endpoint, so those tabs are greyed out.

headers: Anthropic's CORS pre-check answers 400 unless the request names anthropic-dangerous-direct-browser-access, so direct calls from the page send it (checked 2026-11-12 with a real key: the preflight is 200 with it and 400 without). Through server.js the server makes the call, so the page does not send it. The name is Anthropic's warning that a key used from a browser is visible to that page, which is how this playground works (your own key, your own browser, sent only to the provider).
attributionHeaders is false: HTTP-Referer and X-Title mean nothing to Anthropic and are one more thing its CORS could stop allowing.

modelsPaths: GET /models answers {data: [{id, display_name, created_at, max_input_tokens, max_tokens, capabilities, ...}], has_more, first_id, last_id}; the default page is 20 models, so limit=1000 keeps the list whole. It has no prices. Every model is a chat model, so categorize needs nothing here.

Anthropic's own compatibility notes (platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/openai-sdk): thinking is not returned, strict tool schemas are ignored, prompt caching and audio/file inputs are not supported, system and developer messages are merged into one, and most unsupported fields are ignored without an error.
A new API account may get a small starter credit (the amount is not published; check the console). Not tested here: a real chat completion through the page.
guide is the text of the Welcome page's box: how hard the setup is (level 1-4 and ease), a summary, the steps, and what is good or to watch. Shown with the signup link.
label: Anthropic (Claude)

signup.text: No key? Get one at Anthropic

guide.summary: Claude models straight from Anthropic. Make an account, create a key, paste it. Only the Chat tab and the chat steps in the tools work; there is no image, video or speech here.
steps: Make an account at console.anthropic.com (the API console, separate from the Claude chat app).
Add a payment method or credit if the console asks. New accounts may get a small starter credit; check the console for what you have.
Create a key under API keys and paste it at the top of this page.
good: Works straight from this page (GitHub Pages), no server needed.
One key and one bill with Anthropic, with no router in between.
watch: Chat only: the image and video tools need another provider. Thinking is not shown, and some chat options are ignored (Anthropic's OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a subset).
Your key is used straight from your browser. Anthropic calls that "dangerous" in the name of the header it requires. Make a key just for this, with a spend limit.
Pay as you go: the key spends your credit.
